decisive_items: inappropriately normal phosphate excretion for the degree of hypophosphatemia
severe left knee pain and bilateral genu valgum deformity
response.rationale: Only supplied candidate; low phosphate with renal phosphate wasting and valgus deformity support a hypophosphatemic rickets phenotype, but undetectable FGF23 and elevated 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D are atypical for X-linked hypophosphatemia.
